description:
We live in a world where technology is rapidly changing the educational experiences of students and teachers everywhere, and we have the opportunity to shape how this change takes place. Kira's mission is to harness transformative AI technologies to make world-class personalized teaching and learning accessible to everyone. Kira is a rapidly growing startup backed by top-tier Venture Capital funds including New Enterprise Associates (NEA), Andrew Ng's AI Fund, and Primavera. Our platform is now live in classrooms across El Salvador, so what you ship reaches students and teachers at national scale.




As a mid-level Software Engineer, you will own meaningful, multi-week features that teachers and students use every day: React/TypeScript product surfaces, real-time and AI-streaming UI, and the APIs behind them. This role is for an engineer with roughly 3–6 years of experience who already ships independently and wants more ownership, scope, and influence on a small, high-trust team. You'll partner closely with product and design, learn from senior engineers through code review and design discussions, and contribute some backend work as projects require.



This is a full-time position that may require flexibility with work hours and availability outside of regular business hours. We have offices in San Francisco, CA and New York City, NY. We ask that employees work from one of the two locations and come into the office in person 4 days a week (Wednesdays WFH).




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own and ship end-to-end frontend features, from scoping through production, with increasing independence and minimal hand-holding

 - Build polished, accessible UI in React and TypeScript for teachers and students, including real-time and LLM-backed experiences

 - Work across the stack as needed: backend services, APIs, and the data behind them (our stack includes Kotlin/Spring Boot, Python, and MySQL)

 - Partner with product managers and designers to shape requirements, UX quality, and tradeoffs

 - Debug real production issues and improve reliability, performance, and code quality

 - Write tested, production-quality code deployed through our CI/CD pipeline

 - Use AI coding tools (such as Cursor and Claude Code) as part of your daily workflow, and review and understand everything they produce

 - Contribute to design discussions and code reviews, and help raise the bar for newer engineers
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent technical experience

 - 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience (we're open to standout candidates outside this range), with a frontend-leaning focus

 - Strong React and TypeScript experience, including ownership of multi-week, user-facing features in production

 - Strong CSS skills and an eye for UX quality, with experience in systems such as Tailwind or SCSS

 - Working backend and full-stack fundamentals: APIs, relational databases (for example MySQL), and willingness to ramp up on Kotlin and Python

 - Familiarity with automated testing and CI/CD practices for reliable frontend delivery

 - A substantive project you can walk us through in detail: what you owned, the decisions and tradeoffs you made, and what you would do differently

 - AI-assisted development as a real workflow (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar), with the judgment to question, debug, and explain what the AI produces

 - Independent debugging ability: you can diagnose and fix issues without heavy guidance

 - Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to product and design partners

 - Comfort in a fast-paced, early-stage environment with changing priorities, and genuine interest in Kira's mission in education
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Startup or fast-growing company experience

 - Prior Kotlin or Spring Boot experience

 - Experience building streaming, real-time, or LLM-backed UI

 - Cloud experience (ideally AWS)

 - Experience building for accessibility, localization, or low-bandwidth and varied-device users

 - Mentoring interns or junior engineers





WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation and equity. For applicants in the US, the salary range for this role is $165,000 - $195,000 depending on relevant experience and skill set

 - Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including a medical insurance plan with 100% coverage of employee premiums

 - Flexible PTO policy and company holidays

 - DoorDash credit for lunch daily

 - Wellhub Membership: 100% company-paid access to premium gym networks (Orangetheory, SoulCycle), 60+ wellness apps (Headspace, MyFitnessPal, Apple Fitness+), and 1:1 coaching sessions spanning fitness, mental health, nutrition, and sleep

 - 401(k) matching

 - Dog friendly office
   
   

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

At Kira, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information (including characteristics and testing), military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Kira believes that diversity and inclusion among our employees are critical to our success as a company, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool. Selection for employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.



Background Check

Kira will make a conditional job offer in line with local, state and federal laws, and a subsequent criminal, education, and employment history background check will then be issued.
